transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:

transcript.text: I've noticed some mild blurry vision since the surgery, and I'm a bit concerned about it. Could you provide more information about why that might be happening?

transcript.text:

transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:

transcript.text:

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
